edges.reason: The hypergeometric table is a probability distribution on a without-replacement success count; discrete-distribution meaning is directly contained in this representation.
Interpreting nK/N as the expected count requires the expectation concept, rather than merely multiplying three unexplained parameters.
The mean formula nK/N uses the population size, success count and draw count that define the hypergeometric sampling model.
